body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). The fleet config, egress, fleet-entry, and preflight test suites (config.test.mjs, egress.test.mjs, fleet-entry.test.mjs, preflight.test.mjs) manually invoke mkdtempSync and manage fixture cleanups via manual try/finally blocks calling rmSync or server/process closes, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t, and server/process tear-down can be cleanly scheduled via t.after.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In packages/fleet/test/config.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit' and remove mkdtempSync from node:fs import.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'fleet-config-').
2. In packages/fleet/test/egress.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit' and remove mkdtempSync from node:fs import.
   - Update scratch(t, prefix) helper to accept t and return realpathSync(tmp(t, prefix)).
   - Update withProxy(t, allowlist, fn) helper to accept t, use scratch(t, 'egress-'), schedule proxy cleanup via t.after(() => proxy.close()), and eliminate try/finally block.
   - Update echo server tests to accept t and schedule echo cleanup via t.after(() => echo.close()), eliminating try/finally blocks.
   - Update tests creating scratch dirs or child processes / servers to schedule tear-down via t.after, eliminating all remaining try/finally blocks.
3. In packages/fleet/test/fleet-entry.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit' and remove mkdtempSync from node:fs imports.
   - Update tests to accept t, replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, prefix), and remove try/finally blocks.
4. In packages/fleet/test/preflight.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit' and remove mkdtempSync from node:fs import.
   - Update tmp helper or test calls to accept t and delegate to tmp(t, 'fleet-preflight-').
5. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove 'packages/fleet/test/config.test.mjs', 'packages/fleet/test/egress.test.mjs', 'packages/fleet/test/fleet-entry.test.mjs', and 'packages/fleet/test/preflight.test.mjs' from the ALLOWLIST set.
6. Verification:
   - node --test packages/fleet/test/config.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/egress.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/fleet-entry.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/preflight.test.mjs exits 0.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -c 'finally' packages/fleet/test/config.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/egress.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/fleet-entry.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/preflight.test.mjs outputs 0, 0, 0, 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 packages/fleet/test/config.test.mjs, egress.test.mjs, fleet-entry.test.mjs, and preflight.test.mjs contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 4 test files.
- AC3 None of the 4 test files appear in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs ALLOWLIST.
- AC4 node --test packages/fleet/test/config.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/egress.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/fleet-entry.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/preflight.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(fleet): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit in config, egress, and entry tests
